### Problem

The use case that is awkward or impossible today.

### Proposed solution

What you would like go-gostls to do, and the API shape you have in mind.

### Alternatives considered

Other approaches you evaluated and why they fall short.

### Additional context

Relevant RFCs or GOST standards, links to peer implementations, or anything
else that helps scope the change.

Note: this module is TLS 1.2 client-only by design. TLS 1.3, the server role,
session resumption and renegotiation are out of scope.
